title: Bounded Dyson maps and cavity-driven transitions in a time-dependent non-Hermitian spin-boson model
summary: We study a time-dependent non-Hermitian extension of the Schütte-Da Providência spin-boson Hamiltonian with complex couplings. A time-dependent Dyson map relates the model to a Hermitian counterpart and induces a positive physical metric. Separating the positive and unitary parts of the map, we prove a no-go result for a natural Gaussian number-squeeze-number class: for a nonvanishing linear spin-boson interaction, Hermiticity and bounded invertibility force the entire bosonic part of the Dyson map to be unitary.
